parameters.name: GroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the application. You can obtain the application ID on the **Application Management** page in the SchedulerX console.

parameters.name: Namespace
parameters.description: The ID of the namespace. You can obtain the namespace ID on the **Namespace** page in the SchedulerX console.

parameters.name: NamespaceSource
parameters.description: The source of the namespace. This parameter is required only for a special third party.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable the job. Valid values:

*   **0**: disables the job.
*   **1**: enables the job.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun schedulerx2 list-jobs --group-id DocTest.Group --namespace 1a72ecb1-b4cc-400a-a71b-20cdec9b0000 --namespace-source schedulerx --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --job-name helloword --status 1 --page-num 1 --page-size 1 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun schedulerx2 ListJobs --region cn-hangzhou --Status 1 --PageNum 1 --PageSize 1 --NamespaceSource schedulerx --JobName helloword --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --Namespace '1a72ecb1-b4cc-400a-a71b-20cdec9b0000' --GroupId 'DocTest.Group'
